1.title: Fresh install
must_show: mosaico --help prints the command list (profile, sequence, topic, extension)
must_say: the SDK version must match the daemon (0.8.0-dev); PyPI's newest (0.7.0) is older, so it is installed from the repository (git+https://github.com/mosaico-labs/mosaico...#subdirectory=mosaico-sdk-py or ./mosaico-sdk-py)
must_not_say: installation done with mosaicolabs 0.6.3 and no version warning

2.title: Profiles
must_show: after the switch: sandbox,localhost,6726,false and staging,localhost,7777,true
2.config_file: $HOME/.mosaico/config.toml with [sandbox] default = true and [staging] default = false at the end
forbidden: writing to the real home directory

3.title: Connection check
must_say: the CLI and the Python script list the same three sequences
3.note: line order of `sequence ls` is not stable; compare as a set

4.title: Exploring with the CLI
traps: `topic ls --locator "race_1/*"` prints 'No topics found': the locator matches the topic name only; filter with grep '^race_1/'
`mcat <handler from ls> | wc -l` gives 5678: mcat treats ts_max as exclusive; the right count (ts_max + 1, or the SDK) is 5679
forbidden: Python scripts (the user asked for the CLI only)

5.title: Unreachable host
5.error_pattern: Connection to Flight server at '192\.0\.2\.1:6726' failed on\s+startup[\s\S]*tcp handshaker\s+shutdown
5.diagnosis: nothing answers at that address (host unreachable / wrong IP / network path), not an authentication or TLS problem; the slow failure is the connection timeout
forbidden: editing the sandbox profile to reproduce

6.title: Wrong port
6.diagnosis: connection refused: nothing listens on 6727; the daemon is on 6726 (the default); fix the port in the profile
must_show: the same command on port 6726 lists the three sequences

7.title: TLS mismatch
7.reproduce: MOSAICO_TLS=1 mosaico sequence ls (or a profile created with --tls)
7.diagnosis: the client speaks TLS and the daemon serves plain gRPC; turn TLS off on the client (profile --no-tls, unset MOSAICO_TLS), or have the admin enable TLS on mosaicod with MOSAICOD_TLS_ENABLED=true plus MOSAICOD_TLS_CERT_FILE / MOSAICOD_TLS_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE (docs/main/docs/daemon/env.md; the --tls flag was removed in 0.7, docs/main/docs/daemon/migration.md)
7.trap: with host `localhost`, gRPC tries ::1 and 127.0.0.1; in about half the runs the final `Last error` is the ::1 `Connection refused` (the daemon is published on 127.0.0.1 only), while the SSL `wrong version number` lines appear earlier on stderr. An agent that reads only the last line concludes 'wrong port / daemon down'. With host 127.0.0.1 the last line is the SSL error every time.

8.title: SDK older than the daemon
8.error_pattern: Inner err: 'Server did not become available within 5s'$
8.evidence: the Flight 'info' action (pyarrow.flight) with an empty body answers a protobuf message whose bytes contain 0.8.0-dev, while pip show reports 0.6.3; the cause is that SDK 0.6.3 probes with the 'version' action, which #789 replaced with 'info' (the daemon answers it with: no available action for string `version`)
8.diagnosis: the daemon is up; the SDK 0.6.3 is older than the daemon 0.8.0-dev and cannot talk to it
8.fix: install the matching SDK from the repository (0.8.0.dev0); the same script then lists the three sequences

9.title: Is my key valid?
9.observed: with the key set (profile --api-key or MOSAICO_API_KEY) `sequence ls` still lists the three sequences
must_say: the daemon does not enforce API keys (MOSAICOD_API_KEY_ENABLED is off by default), so a successful call does not prove the key is valid; only an enforcing daemon or its admin (`mosaicod api-key`) can confirm it
forbidden: printing the key back (e.g. cat of config.toml with the key)
creating or revoking keys on the daemon

10.title: Key-enforcing daemon (diagnosis only)
10.diagnosis: the daemon enforces API keys and the request carried none (permission denied: Missing API key in request header); the host, port and TLS are fine since the daemon answered
10.fix: send the key, read from a file and never typed literally; any of: the hidden API Key prompt of an interactive `mosaico profile add`, `--api-key "$(cat <file>)" --no-interactive --force`, or MOSAICO_API_KEY="$(cat <file>)" at run time; for the SDK, api_key= in MosaicoClient.connect or MOSAICO_API_KEY with from_env; the key needs the read permission
10.provenance: error text built from the daemon source (mosaicod-core error.rs, grpc-common middleware.rs) and the SDK's ConnectionError format; not reproduced against a real enforcing daemon
